canonical_facts: Transcript email is an explicit per-item or per-subscription action.
One bounded plain-text transcript and title enter premium request memory.
The premium database retains delivery metadata but no transcript, title, audio, feed URL, or recipient.
The captured DEV Maildir retains delivered development mail and no SMTP provider is configured.
Local mode creates no premium-service operation.
Local is distinct from online free and online premium.
Private-web content is available only after explicit pairing over the exact tailnet HTTPS origin.
The browser credential is HttpOnly, short-lived, scoped to /web/, and is not returned in content responses.
Ads are bounded first-party house text rendered natively.
No third-party ad SDK, tracker, executable creative, remote creative image, or impression beacon is admitted.

legacy_fences.assertion: Device authorization codes use secure-window containment and are not rememberSaveable.
Known ad, tracker, analytics, crash, and remote-image dependencies are forbidden.
House creative uses native text and only designated placements.
Advertising and attribution permissions are forbidden and INTERNET is the sole manifest permission.
Known executable creative and tracking source APIs are forbidden.
Known third-party ad dependencies remain absent from desktop and core manifests.
Desktop house creative cannot use HTML, webviews, images, scripts, impressions, or analytics.
window.api exposes exactly the reviewed payload-only method set.
Transcript HTML runs in an opaque-origin scripts-only iframe without preload or parent access.
Local core and desktop dependency closures exclude the premium service package.
Premium vocabulary appears only in reviewed desktop boundary consumers and premium modules cannot import loopback engine code.
The engine bearer is absent from renderer-reachable serialized state.
Renderer IPC declarations contain no access, refresh, authorization, or bearer fields.
Extension engine requests use only reviewed loopback routes with bearer headers and no redirect credential path.
Pairing and tracked jobs use exact versioned storage.local envelopes and never storage.sync.
Private-web public, session, library, search, and transcript route methods are exact and default-deny.
Private-web pairing, scoped session, no-store, CSP, origin, path confinement, and minimized response proofs remain.
Premium README contains the approved content-stateless request and retaining DEV sink disclosure.
The motivating unconditional no-transcript-service claim is mechanically rejected.
All discovered public copy surfaces remain scanned for unconditional local-only transcript claims.
